privacy: Files stay on your device. No uploads or live resource requests.
drop: Drop an MHTML or MHT file here
formats: Read a saved web page with its bundled images and styles.
invalid: This archive is damaged or contains no readable HTML page. Try saving a new web archive in the original application.
emptyFile: This file is empty. Choose a saved web archive with content.
resourceLimit: Your browser ran out of resources while opening this archive. Close other tabs and try again.
unsupported: Choose a local MHTML or MHT web archive. Website addresses and plain HTML files are not supported here.
structure: This archive uses an unsupported multipart structure or transfer encoding. Try saving the page again as a single MHTML file.
email: This file appears to be an email message. Open it with the email viewer instead.
noContent: The saved page has no readable content. It may be blank or depend on interactive content.
localResources: Some bundled images, styles, or fonts are missing or use an unsupported format. The saved page may look different.
remoteResources: Some resources were not included in this archive. Live replacements remain blocked, so the saved page may look different.
truncated: This archive is incomplete: its closing boundary is missing. Recovered content is shown, but text or resources may be cut off.
nested: This archive contains embedded or additional pages. Only the main saved page is shown; nested pages and embedded apps are omitted.
encoding: Some archive parts declare an unsupported text encoding. Recovered text may contain incorrect characters.
safePreview: Scripts, forms, redirects, and embedded apps are disabled. External links open only when you select them. The original location is shown for reference only.
missingReference: This internal reference could not be found in the saved page.
